requirements.evidence: Data model matches the contract: entities_slug_unique (create_entities_table.php:17), owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner and entity_memberships_entity_user_unique (create_entity_memberships_table.php:24-31). Policies match the spec (EntityPolicy.php:12-36, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:11-34). Pick controller aborts 403 before touching the session, logs to Log::channel('audit') and redirects (EntitySelectionController.php:17-30). Members: exists:users,email (Members.php:47), duplicate check -> error on email (Members.php:52-56), role restricted to UserRole::manageable() (Members.php:79-89), owner/last-manager removal -> 403 (Members.php:113-121). Settings: slug unique ignoring itself (Settings.php:54), delete soft-deletes + memberships + clears session (Settings.php:68-77), transfer locks rows, requires an admin of this entity other than the caller, 403 when the owner is missing, demotes before promoting (Settings.php:86-108). Dashboard shows the settings link/owner notice only when manageSettings (dashboard.blade.php:7-20). Gaps: slug has no format rule (alpha_dash), so a slug with '/' or spaces can be saved and break routing (Settings.php:50-55); the last-manager check is not atomic.

conventions.evidence: No test files anywhere in the diff, despite 'No production code without a test'. Domain writes (add member, assign role, remove, save, delete, transfer) are done inline in the Livewire components (Members.php:59, Members.php:98, Settings.php:57, Settings.php:68-71, Settings.php:104-105) instead of app/Actions/* classes. Livewire validation uses inline $this->validate([...]) and Validator::make (Members.php:46, Members.php:79) rather than the project's #[Validate] pattern. CHANGELOG.md not updated. Positives: authorization via policies, #[Fillable] set deliberately (Entity.php:14, EntityMembership.php:12), docs/database-schema.md updated, reuses <x-form-field>/<x-button>.

security.evidence: Every public action re-resolves the entity from a #[Locked] boundEntityId and authorizes (Members.php:41-43, 74-76, 105-111; Settings.php:43-45, 64-66, 82-84); membership IDs are scoped to the entity and authorized (Members.php:141-147). Output escaped with {{ }} throughout the Blade views. Minor gaps: unlocked unused public int $entityId on all three components (Dashboard.php:17, Members.php:24, Settings.php:20) is a client-writable property; $targetMembershipId has no validation (Settings.php:28), though it is resolved and scoped server-side; last-manager removal check has no transaction/lock (Members.php:115-121).

tests.evidence: The diff contains no tests/ files: no feature tests for routes, policies, the DB one-owner constraint, the pick endpoint, or any Livewire action, and none of the unauthorized-call/tamper tests the Livewire policy mandates.

simplicity.evidence: Each component keeps three copies of the entity identity (#[Locked] boundEntityId, unused public $entityId, public Entity $entity) and refetches via findOrFail (Members.php:21-26, 136-139). Duplicate lang keys with identical text: entity_welcome/dashboard_welcome and owner_notice/entity_owner_notice (lang/en/ui.php:53-56, pt_BR equivalent). Redundant owner checks repeated after the policy already denies (Members.php:95, 113). Otherwise direct code reusing Eloquent relations and existing Blade components.

readability.evidence: Clear names, small methods, helpful comments (Settings.php:101-103, migration comment at create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-23). Dead public $entityId and unused duplicate lang keys reduce clarity; the hand-built Validator in assignRole (Members.php:79-89) is harder to read than a #[Validate]/Rule::enum approach.

scope.evidence: All files serve the task: models, enum, policies, factories, migrations, three Livewire pages and views, pick controller, routes, lang keys, and the schema doc requested by the task. No onboarding, switcher, middleware or navbar work.

issues.explanation: The change ships no tests at all, violating the mandatory TDD convention and the Livewire policy's requirement for unauthorized-call and tamper tests on every action.
Domain writes (add/assign/remove member, save, delete, transfer ownership) are performed directly in Livewire components instead of one app/Actions/* class per use case.
Validation uses inline rule arrays and Validator::make instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern, and $targetMembershipId has no validation.
Slug is only required|string|max:255|unique, so values with spaces or slashes can be saved and produce broken /e/{slug} URLs; an alpha_dash rule is missing.
Unused, unlocked public int $entityId is a client-writable property carrying server context; it should be removed or #[Locked].
The last-manager count check and delete are not in a transaction with locking, so two concurrent removals could leave the entity without a manager.
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] was not updated as the docs-sync convention requires.
dashboard_welcome and entity_owner_notice duplicate entity_welcome and owner_notice and are never used.
Public Entity $entity is stored but every action refetches by boundEntityId, so the property is redundant state.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model (including the portable one-owner generated column), policies, the pick endpoint and the dashboard/members/settings Livewire pages with solid server-side authorization and entity-scoped lookups. However, it ships no tests whatsoever, which the conventions treat as mandatory, and it bypasses the Actions layer and #[Validate] pattern, so it needs substantial rework before approval.
